problem: A small well specified task takes too long through the ExitCode extension
happyPath: The task completes correctly through the extension within twenty minutes
constraints: Exercise the candidate extension with an identified Pi installation and fixed model
Measure from task submission through verified completion including discovery and preparation
The fixture supplies immediate simulated user approval after acceptance is ready
The scheduled live trial must pass and an incomplete trial remains a failure

scenarios.description: Complete a concrete small artifact task in a fresh Pi fixture
scenarios.instructions: Use Pi with the candidate ExitCode extension to solve the supplied goal. Report observed completion and independently read the resulting file. Do not modify the fixture outside the Pi session.

input.goal: The result.txt file says pending. It should say done followed by a newline. Keep settings.json unchanged.

fixtureFiles.AGENTS.md: Make the smallest change that solves the requested task. Preserve unrelated files.
